description: This file defines the interface for the String Component Object in the system, declaring functions for creation, removal, object enrollment, and initialization of the string component. It serves as a contract for other components or modules interacting with the string component, outlining the exported API functions.

methods.name: AnscCreateStringComponent
methods.description: Creates a new string component instance using provided handle contexts.

methods.name: AnscStringCOCreate
methods.description: Creates an instance of the string component object with given context handles.

methods.name: AnscStringCORemove
methods.description: Removes or deallocates the string component object.

methods.name: AnscStringCOEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls or registers the component's objects within the system context.

methods.name: AnscStringCOInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the string component object, setting up necessary internal states.
